sentiment.rationale: The document reports a strong Q2 with adjusted EPS up 20% and total segment operating income up 15%, but full-year guidance for adjusted EPS ($5.75, +16%) and Experiences (6-8% growth) was reaffirmed, not raised. Management expressed increased confidence in the guidance ('certainly gives us confidence an even higher level of covenants') but explicitly declined to raise it ('we think it would be premature at this point to change the guidance'). The forward signal is therefore one of genuine operational momentum without a formal guidance raise, warranting a score of +0.25.

summary.revenue: Q2 fiscal 2025 revenues increased 7% to $23.6 billion from $22.1 billion in Q2 fiscal 2024.
summary.eps: Q2 fiscal 2025 diluted EPS improved to $1.81 from a loss per share of $0.01 in Q2 fiscal 2024; adjusted EPS increased 20% to $1.45 from $1.21.
summary.guidance: Fiscal year 2025: adjusted EPS of $5.75 (+16% over fiscal 2024); Entertainment double-digit segment operating income growth; Sports 18% segment operating income growth; Experiences 6% to 8% segment operating income growth; cash provided by operations of $17 billion. Q3 fiscal 2025: modest increase in Disney+ subscribers compared to Q2 fiscal 2025.
key_risks: Higher programming and production costs at Sports due to airing three additional College Football Playoff games and an additional NFL game.
Sports operating income adversely impacted by a write-off due to exiting the Venu joint venture.
Equity loss from India JV of ~$300 million driven by purchase accounting amortization.
Disney Cruise Line pre-opening expense of ~$200 million.
Uncertainty regarding the operating environment for the balance of the fiscal year due to macroeconomic developments.
key_opportunities: Direct-to-Consumer operating income increased $289 million to $336 million.
180.7 million Disney+ and Hulu subscriptions, an increase of 2.5 million versus Q1 fiscal 2025.
Domestic Parks & Experiences operating income grew 13% to $1.8 billion.
Upcoming theatrical slate, launch of ESPN's new DTC offering, and expansion projects in Experiences.
Paid sharing and technology enhancements expected to drive subscriber growth.
